summary: Iteration 2 full-stack test of EvoNut MVP (Lab Exam upload + Branded PDF generation). Backend: 34/35 pytest tests pass (15 new iter2 + 20 iter1 regression all pass except 1). Frontend: Patient detail now correctly shows 6 tabs (Anamnese, Análise IA, Antropometria, Exames, Plano Alimentar, Comparativo). Exames tab renders the upload card, history list, and right-side preview panel. Plano tab has both 'Baixar PDF' (data-testid=download-plan-pdf) and 'Imprimir' (data-testid=print-plan) buttons; PDF endpoint returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. Lab exam AI extraction (Claude Sonnet 4.5) successfully parsed a synthetic 12-marker PDF and flagged abnormal values (Vit D 22 / Glicemia 102 / Colesterol 215) with status atencao/prioridade. Auth-guard works on all new endpoints (401 unauth, 404 cross-tenant). PDF endpoint correctly returns 404 for invalid plan_id or patient_id. Non-PDF and empty/scanned PDF correctly rejected with 400. AI budget appears OK in this iteration (iter1's only failure no longer reproduces).

critical.issue: Review request states 'GET /api/patients/{id} now also returns exams[] in the response payload', but the implementation in server.py:get_patient does NOT fetch or include exams. Response keys are only [patient, anamneses, consultations, evaluations, meal_plans, ai_analyses]. Frontend PacienteDetalhe likely fetches exams separately via GET /exams (which works), so UI is OK, but contract is incomplete vs spec.

minor.issue: ai_exam_analysis fallback (when JSON parse fails) returns markers=[] silently — front-end will just show 'no markers detected' without indicating the LLM returned malformed output. Consider logging a warning and surfacing a friendlier resumo.
Accepts an untyped dict body (no Pydantic model). Should use a typed model like ExamNotesIn(observacoes: str) for input validation.
WeasyPrint is invoked synchronously in the request handler — for large plans this can block the event loop. Consider running HTML(...).write_pdf in a thread executor (asyncio.to_thread).
Returns {ok:true} even when the exam id does not exist (delete_one matched 0 docs). Should return 404 if not found for proper REST semantics.

action_items: Update GET /api/patients/{pid} in server.py to also fetch exams (db.exams.find({paciente_id:pid},{_id:0, raw_text:0})) and return them under an 'exams' key — required by the iter2 spec.
Type the PATCH /exams/{eid} body with a Pydantic model (ExamNotesIn).
Wrap PDF generation in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop on large plans.
Return 404 from DELETE /exams/{eid} when no document was matched (use deleted_count).
Optional: when ai_exam_analysis can't parse JSON, log it and return a clearer fallback message in 'resumo' so the user knows the AI output was malformed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 850 lines — past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, public, patients, exams, pdf), services/ai.py, services/calc.py, helpers/pdf.py before iter 3 to keep maintainability.

_md_to_html is a hand-rolled mini-parser that doesn't escape HTML in user content (e.g. '<script>' inside plan.content would be rendered literally inside the PDF). For PDF this is low-risk, but escape via html.escape() before applying markdown transforms.
ai_exam_analysis truncates raw text to 8000 chars silently — labs with 4-5 page hemograms could lose data. Consider chunking or warning the user.

Exam upload reads the entire file into memory (await file.read()) before checking size — a malicious user could send a 1GB PDF and exhaust memory before the 10MB check fires. Use file.spool_max_size or stream-check.
No mime-type validation on UploadFile — relies only on filename extension. A user could rename a .exe → .pdf and pdfplumber would just throw the generic 400 'Não foi possível ler o PDF' message.
PDF endpoint embeds nutri.name into HTML without escaping — if a nutritionist registers with name='Dra X' it would render as bold in the PDF. Same minor XSS-like issue for patient name and phone.
Re-iterating from iter1: localhost CORS fallback, /api/leads single-nutritionist routing, slot timezone bug (UTC vs America/Sao_Paulo) still unaddressed.

rca of the issue: test_patient_detail_includes_exams — RCA: The review_request explicitly states 'GET /api/patients/{id} now also returns exams[] in the response payload' but server.py:get_patient (line 526-537) only queries anamneses/consultations/evaluations/meal_plans/ai_analyses — not exams. Reproduction: GET /api/patients/{pid} after uploading an exam → response keys do not contain 'exams'. Mitigation: add `exams = await db.exams.find({'paciente_id': pid}, {'_id': 0, 'raw_text': 0}).sort('created_at', -1).to_list(50)` and include `'exams': exams` in the return dict. Frontend already fetches exams separately so UI is unaffected, but the API contract is incomplete.
